headline: Midwestern State stand alone without a defeat
dek: Midwestern State have won twelve and drawn four without a defeat, beating Lubbock Christian on Wednesday. Jake Morris has kept five clean sheets in goal, and the side have conceded thirteen goals all season.
displaced_by: Midwestern State's win over Lubbock Christian made it twelve wins and thirteen goals conceded, so the standing dek was no longer true. The headline still holds and stands verbatim.

pattern.text: Eleven different players have scored Midwestern State's 44 goals, and Parker Plaxco has thirteen of them.
